04 · Ecosystem engagement

Part of Singapore’sinnovation community.

Singapore’s edge is how closely government, universities, startups and industry work together, and we’re part of that. Since 2016 our Innovation Lab has worked with local agencies, universities and startups, and our tech talks and meetups open our doors to the wider community.

06 · Our tech spirit

Keeping the techspirit alive.

High-performing teams stay engaged when work feels like a team sport. From tournaments to SDC gatherings, we make time to compete, celebrate and connect, and make this a great place to work.

Some who joined us in 2007 are still building with us, and we’ve been rated amongst Singapore’s most attractive employers by Universum since 2022.

07 · Growing with purpose, 2027–2030

Where we’re headed

Our plan for 2027 to 2030: grow steadily, year on year, from the 318 colleagues we expect at the end of 2026 to 379, with 370 as the minimum target.
